session: one session, one idle RTX 5090, measured back to back against the exllamav3 lane

checkpoint.served_as: the snapshot path directly — --revision does not reach the runner (known open bug)

pack.state: REBUILT this session — the pre-existing pack predated two codegen/golden commits (8c43c3c9 run-fused column decode, eff405ac routed-expert m256 golden) and a pack hit ignores compiler-source and golden changes

boot2.note: pack hit after the harness reaped boot1 mid-c16; the c1 control reproduces boot1 to 0.1 % (22.92 vs 22.94 tok/s, TPOT 31.03 vs 31.00), which is what makes the split comparable

boot3_quality_only.note: NOT a serving measurement. The served config has 22 MiB free and OOMs on prompt_logprobs over vocab 151552; utilization was lowered only so the logits buffer fits. Same pack, same kernels, same fp8 KV dtype.

client.protocol: random dataset, 512 in / 128 out, --ignore-eos, N=8/24/48/64 at c=1/4/8/16, 1 discarded warmup, 2 recorded reps, 1 Hz nvidia-smi poll

handicaps: the prefill trunk goldens measured in Part 1 are deliberately withheld
